_comment: Railway reads one service from this file. Deploy two services from the same
repo and override the start command on the second:
worker     -> adagent worker      (drains the job queue)
scheduler  -> adagent scheduler   (enqueues the recurring loop)
Add Railway Postgres and set ADAGENT_POSTGRES__DSN from its DATABASE_URL.
Point ADAGENT_CLICKHOUSE__* at ClickHouse Cloud and set SECURE=true.
Run migrations once after the first deploy:  railway run adagent db migrate
Keep ADAGENT_META__DRY_RUN=true until you have reviewed a full week of
